## Outcome

What should this issue produce?

## Workstream

## Owner

## Status

Choose one: `needs owner`, `scoping`, `in progress`, `ready for review`, `blocked`, `done`

## Next Step

## Review or Decision Needed

What feedback, approval, decision, or review window is needed?

## Links

## Acceptance Criteria

What has to be true before this can close?

## Notes
